atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the @tailwind directive to insert Tailwind's base, components, utilities, and screens styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use @apply to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use the @layer directive to tell Tailwind which layer a custom utility belongs to.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Use the @config directive to specify which Tailwind configuration file to use when processing your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Use the @variant directive to apply a Tailwind variant to styles in your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Use the @custom-variant directive to define a custom variant in your CSS.
